init.title: Configure
init.description: Edit a favorite or a program stored on this Hatch Rest, or copy them from another.

favorites.title: Set Favorite
favorites.description: Choose a favorite stored on this Hatch Rest to edit.

favorite.title: Favorite {slot}
favorite.description: Saving writes the whole favorite to the Hatch Rest and reads it back.

programs.title: Set Program
programs.description: Choose a program stored on this Hatch Rest to edit.

program.title: Program {slot}
program.description: Saving writes the whole program to the Hatch Rest and reads it back.

copy_favorites.title: Copy Favorites From Other Device
copy_favorites.description: Choose the Hatch Rest to copy favorites from. Only those connected now are listed.

copy_favorite_slots.title: Copy Favorites From {source}
copy_favorite_slots.description: Each favorite ticked is copied into the same slot here, replacing what that slot holds.

copy_programs.title: Copy Programs From Other Device
copy_programs.description: Choose the Hatch Rest to copy programs from. Only those connected now are listed.

copy_program_slots.title: Copy Programs From {source}
copy_program_slots.description: Each program ticked is copied into the same slot here, replacing what that slot holds. Empty slots are not listed, since a slot cannot be emptied.

error.write_failed: The Hatch Rest did not take the program. Nothing was changed; check the logs and try again.
error.duration_too_long: A program can run for at most 18:12:15.
error.name_invalid: Use 1 to 15 plain characters, without accents.
error.favorite_write_failed: The Hatch Rest did not take the favorite. Nothing was changed; check the logs and try again.
error.nothing_selected: Tick at least one to copy.
error.copy_failed: Slot {failed} could not be written, so the copy stopped there. Those already copied are unticked; check the logs and try again.

abort.not_loaded: The Hatch Rest is not set up yet.
abort.programs_unread: The programs have not been read from the Hatch Rest yet. Wait for it to connect, then try again.
abort.favorites_unread: The favorites have not been read from the Hatch Rest yet. Wait for it to connect, then try again.
abort.no_other_devices: No other Hatch Rest is connected to copy from.
abort.source_not_loaded: The Hatch Rest to copy from is no longer connected.
abort.source_favorites_unread: The favorites have not been read from {source} yet. Wait for it to connect, then try again.
abort.source_programs_unread: The programs have not been read from {source} yet. Wait for it to connect, then try again.
